tablet.notes: Fixes a crash in the camera and gallery screen when the photo permission is refused. The crash log (Settings > Crash log) now has Copy and Share at the bottom: Copy copies the whole log, Share sends it as a .txt file. Swiping between screens works from anywhere in the tablet dock layout.
